name: cadomi-ai
description: Connect ChatGPT to CaDoMi.ai for product planning, Agile delivery intelligence, sprint planning, backlog refinement, team agility assessment, and context-aware coaching.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to CaDoMi.ai, an AI-native product management and Agile delivery platform. Plan and refine product backlogs, create user stories and acceptance criteria, prepare and manage sprints, assess team agility, surface delivery risks, analyze capacity and performance, and get context-aware guidance for Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Agile Coaches, developers, leaders, and delivery teams. CaDoMi.ai brings product planning, delivery intelligence, coaching, and continuous improvement together to help teams build better products and deliver measurable value.
defaultPrompt: Use CaDoMi.ai to review my current sprint health and surface delivery risks.
Use CaDoMi.ai to find backlog stories that are not ready for sprint planning.
Use CaDoMi.ai to help create user stories with acceptance criteria for an upcoming feature.
